blocks.text: A variety of disorders can affect the structure and function of the kidneys and urinary tract. The common ones are urinary tract infections, kidney stones, kidney failure and polycystic kidney disease; the following topics describe the first three and their treatments, including dialysis and kidney transplant.

blocks.prompt: Name four common disorders of the urinary tract.
blocks.explanation: Urinary tract infections, kidney stones, kidney failure and polycystic kidney disease.

items: Common disorders: UTIs, kidney stones, kidney failure, polycystic kidney disease.
